title: Site Engineer - TI PR VICTAS (Job 717761)
content_text: Downer Transport & Infrastructure, civil and pavement rehabilitation. Site Engineer based at Dandenong site delivering major road construction projects with travel to regional locations; suits a recent graduate. Bring: tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering or related disciplines; exposure in civil road construction, stabilisation or surfacing highly regarded; ability to work away from home in regional areas frequently; planning, organising and time management; building relationships with stakeholders. Fully maintained vehicle. Apply via the Downer careers Apply button; Downer does not accept applications via email (enquiries: Alicia Jacobson, Talent and Sourcing Business Partner). Job Identification 717761, Engineering and Design, Dandenong South VIC. Seen reposted on Jobstralia and College Recruiter in October 2026.
apply_instructions: Apply on Downer careers (Oracle candidate portal), job 717761. No email applications.
